query:
SELECT
                        id,
                        name,
                        description,
                        habit_type::text  AS "habit_type!",
                        frequency::text   AS "frequency!",
                        archived,
                        created_at,
                        updated_at
                    FROM habits
                    WHERE user_id = $1
                      AND archived = false
                      AND (name ILIKE $2 OR description ILIKE $2)
                    ORDER BY
                        (name ILIKE $3) DESC,
                        updated_at DESC
                    LIMIT $4
